chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
The owner of the goods has more right to set the price.

key_terms.أَحَقُّ: more entitled or having greater right
key_terms.السَّوْمِ: bargaining or the setting/offer of a sale price
key_terms.السِّلْعَةِ: the merchandise or goods being sold

ai.seo_question: Who has the right to set the price of goods in an Islamic sale?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the owner of merchandise holds the primary right regarding its pricing in a sale. It reflects a principle of commercial jurisprudence recognizing the seller’s authority over his property within lawful trade.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: The owner of the goods has more right to set the price."
